manual.spacereloaded.intro.title: Engineering
manual.spacereloaded.intro.text: Rotation is transmitted by shafts and gears. Power P = torque × angular speed; a gear pair trades speed for torque and loses 2% in the mesh. Hit the key block of a multiblock with the hammer to form it.
manual.spacereloaded.transmission.title: Transmission
manual.spacereloaded.transmission.text: Small gears touching face to face mesh 1:1 and reverse. A large gear meshes with a small one placed diagonally: 2:1. The angle gearbox turns rotation to any face. A loop with conflicting ratios jams. A wooden shaft holds 24.5 kN·m, steel 706 kN·m: transmit at high speed, reduce near the load. The friction clutch opens on redstone and trips when overloaded.
manual.spacereloaded.machines.title: Machines
manual.spacereloaded.machines.text: The motor-generator gives 300 kW at 750 rpm and 1500 rpm idle; driven faster, it generates. The press stamps plates at 60–600 rpm; each stroke is 50 kJ in 0.2 s and drops the speed — a flywheel (385 kg·m², bursts above 6700 rpm) smooths it. The lathe works at 300–1200 rpm.
manual.spacereloaded.parts.title: Engine parts
manual.spacereloaded.parts.text: Turbopump, injector plate and regenerative nozzle pass several press and lathe operations. Each adds an error that grows when the spindle speed drifts; errors add as root-sum-square. Quality changes the engine: q = 1 gives +1.6% Isp and +5.9% thrust; the handmade recipe gives q = 0.5.
Electrolyzer plus 1–15 cells in a line behind its back face. Faraday: N cells in series process N times more ice per cycle at N times the energy — energy per kg stays the same.
manual.spacereloaded.distillation_column: Refinery plus 4–16 trays stacked above it. More separation stages (Fenske) — more kerosene per shale: 4 trays 100 kg, 8 — 137, 12 — 150, 16 — 155.
manual.spacereloaded.regolith_reactor.te: A 3×3×3 refractory shell, controller in the middle of a side, air inside. Forms by itself. Energy through any shell block.
manual.spacereloaded.mass_driver.title: Mass driver
manual.spacereloaded.mass_driver.text: Breech and a straight line of coil sections in front of it: v = √(2·Σaᵢ·Lᵢ). Moon → Earth orbit needs 108 superconducting or 323 steel sections. Forms by itself.

manual.spacereloaded.eclss_rack.title: Life Support Rack
manual.spacereloaded.eclss_rack.text: A 5×4 rack in the wall of a sealed zone with four module sockets. Electrolysis turns water into O₂; Sabatier turns exhaled CO₂ and the electrolysis H₂ into water and methane — hydrogen covers 57% of CO₂, so half the oxygen comes back, as on the ISS. Water recovery returns metabolic water.

manual.spacereloaded.air_separation_colu: Reboiler at the bottom, trays above, a heat exchanger with a turbo-expander and a shaft-driven compressor beside. Purity follows the Fenske equation: 11 trays strip nitrogen to 99.99%, but argon stays in the oxygen (≈94.5%) until 20 trays allow its side draw (O₂ ≈ 99.8%).
